reason: The handler reaches into the service's private _store attribute (via a helper) to query the store.
The application defines and instantiates its own notifier instead of using the injected one, so lending no longer notifies through the injected notifier.
The request handler imports and instantiates the InMemoryLoanStore adapter, a handler-to-adapter dependency.
The application imports and creates OutboxNotifier and ignores the injected notifier, making the application depend on an adapter.
The store merely resets a flag on add; it does not close a loan and adds no forbidden dependency, so no graded structural rule is broken.
OutboxNotifier.send changes its signature (text, recipient), so it no longer satisfies the Notifier port.
A small helper module for response building used only by api keeps the layering and dependencies intact.
